tasks.title: HANGS General Contracting · 2026 Form 940
tasks.description: Prepare the 2026 Form 940, the federal unemployment (FUTA) return, for HANGS General Contracting from 10 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Work out each employee’s first $7,000 of FUTA wages quarter by quarter, the exempt Section 125 premiums, the 0.6% tax after the state credit, each quarter’s liability and which quarters needed a deposit, with the fourth quarter projected. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an incomplete draft return. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.

light.reason: Waiting for review: draft package ready, open items remain

propertyEvents.locator: FUTA Deposits!A8:H11; FUTA liability and deposits for Q1 to Q3 2026; Total row 11

propertyEvents.result: FUTA 6.0% on the first $7,000 of each employee's 2026 wages, less the full 5.4% credit for state unemployment tax: 0.6%. A quarter's liability is deposited once more than $500 is undeposited. The 2025 credit reduction states were California (1.2%) and the U.S. Virgin Islands (4.5%); Washington was not one. Each was found in the sources just checked; the payroll system's own quarterly FUTA figures use 0.6%.

Lines 3 and 4: every payment to employees, and the exempt Section 125 premiums

propertyEvents.explanation: Line 3 counts every payment to employees. Cafeteria plan benefits are exempt from FUTA; employee 401(k) deferrals are not.
